senses.sense_definition: A large supply or quantity of something, especially qualities or knowledge, available to be used.

target_lang_translations.fr: Le professeur possédait un immense <w>fonds</w> de connaissances sur l'histoire ancienne.

senses.sense_definition: To provide the money necessary to pay for a project, activity, or organization.
